solutions.cleaning.title: Cleaning robots for business | Professional Robotics
solutions.cleaning.description: Cleaning robots and a platform to manage them: site assessment, pilot, integration, SLA-backed service. We connect robots from any maker. Calculate payback.
solutions.cleaning.name: Robotic cleaning
solutions.cleaning.lead: You can buy a cleaning robot from any dealer. We make it work as part of your business: our software sets tasks, tracks quality and connects the robot to elevators, doors and your systems. No robot yet? We will select one. Already have one? We will connect it.
solutions.cleaning.lead2: The brand you pick should not decide what you manage it with. A fleet of different robots runs in one window.
solutions.cleaning.primaryCta.label: Select a cleaning solution
solutions.cleaning.secondaryCta.label: What our software adds
solutions.cleaning.hero.consoleLabel: A fleet of robots from different brands on one platform
solutions.cleaning.heads.paths: Where to start: three ways in.
solutions.cleaning.heads.pathsLead: The robot is the carrier here; the product is the software that runs it. So you can come to us with a robot or without one.
solutions.cleaning.heads.software: What our software adds to any robot.
solutions.cleaning.heads.softwareLead: On its own a robot just drives around a map. It becomes a cleaning result when a system stands behind it.
solutions.cleaning.heads.directionsLead: By task, not by brand. Prices and speeds below are market benchmarks, not our offer.
solutions.cleaning.heads.economyLead: Two mistakes: taking the spec-sheet speed and assuming the robot replaces the whole crew. We count more carefully.
solutions.cleaning.heads.see: Where it is used and what to read.
solutions.cleaning.paths.items.0.title: You already have a robot.
solutions.cleaning.paths.items.0.text: We connect it to the platform: a shared map, schedule, quality reports and service. If the maker gives access (API or SDK), we integrate it for your workflow. What is possible with your exact model, we tell you at the site assessment, before any deal.
solutions.cleaning.paths.items.1.title: No robot yet.
solutions.cleaning.paths.items.1.text: We select the class and model for your floor, area and schedule. Buy or rent. We launch it on our platform from day one, so the effect shows from the first shift.
solutions.cleaning.paths.items.2.title: You need what the box does not do.
solutions.cleaning.paths.items.2.text: Elevators of several brands, tasks from your 1C, your own reports. We write software for your process within the platform.
solutions.cleaning.problems.items.0.titl: The team relies on people who are harder and harder to hire.
solutions.cleaning.problems.items.0.text: In 2025, extra limits on hiring migrant workers came into force in 11 regions, and sector quotas were proposed for 2026.
solutions.cleaning.problems.items.1.cap: growth of cleaning companies’ payroll over five years
solutions.cleaning.problems.items.1.text: DAKO Professional estimates that payroll in cleaning grew two to three times. Forecast for 2025: cleaning prices up 10–15% because of the labor shortage.
solutions.cleaning.problems.items.2.cap: growth in demand for cleaning workers, year on year, first half of 2026
solutions.cleaning.problems.items.2.text: A robot does not replace the whole crew: it takes flat floors and repeating routes, and people keep restrooms, corners and quality control.

solutions.cleaning.software.items.0.text: Robots of different brands and classes appear on one map: status, charge, errors.
solutions.cleaning.software.items.0.out: one screen instead of an app for every brand
solutions.cleaning.software.items.1.text: The platform builds the schedule and splits the area between robots, so they do not get in each other’s way or leave gaps.
solutions.cleaning.software.items.2.titl: A report of what was actually cleaned
solutions.cleaning.software.items.2.text: What was cleaned, when and how long it took. Operation history and deviations from the standard.
solutions.cleaning.software.items.2.out: you see the result, not hours of work
solutions.cleaning.software.items.3.text: We link the robot to building systems and your software through the platform API, so it moves between floors on its own.
solutions.cleaning.software.items.4.text: A fault becomes a ticket automatically and the response time is recorded. Predictive maintenance reports wear in advance.
solutions.cleaning.software.items.5.text: Need logic that does not come in the box? We write software for your process within one platform.
solutions.cleaning.software.items.5.out: built for your task, not for a catalog
solutions.cleaning.softwareNote: How deep the integration goes depends on the access the maker gives: an open API, an SDK or only the cloud. We check this at the site assessment, before you buy.
solutions.cleaning.directions.items.0.ti: Scrubber robots for large flat areas
solutions.cleaning.directions.items.0.te: Offices, sales floors, lobbies, warehouses with flat floors. The main class: most orders come here.
solutions.cleaning.directions.items.1.ti: Large machines for warehouses and plants
solutions.cleaning.directions.items.1.te: Large areas, night and round-the-clock shifts, heavy soiling. We have not checked the spec-sheet speeds of large machines: at the pilot we measure output at your site.
solutions.cleaning.directions.items.2.te: Carpets, halls with fabric, dust. Dry and wet cleaning use different working units and give different output: we count hard floor and carpet separately.
solutions.cleaning.directions.items.3.te: A separate task with its own equipment and its own economics. Covered on the office buildings page.
solutions.cleaning.directionsNote: The spec-sheet speed is almost always higher than the real one: even the Gausium dealer gives 300–700 m²/h in practice and 1,180 m²/h in theory for the Phantas. Count on the real one.
solutions.cleaning.econ.how.title: Our assumptions
RUB 67,000 a month plus 30% employer social contributions
on one shift, no more than 2 FTEs per robot and no more than half of the team
30% of the floor work: corners, edges, spots
8% of the robot price a year, brushes and electricity RUB 60,000 a year, platform operator share RUB 120,000 a year
solutions.cleaning.econ.market.title: What the market says
solutions.cleaning.econ.market.rows.item: One robot, one shift, savings of about RUB 1.8M a year. Calculated from the assumptions on the left; recalculated for your site in the calculator.
Komandor chain: Pudu CC1 in 12 hypermarkets
Cleaning payroll −25%, staff 8 → 6 people. Night cleaning stayed with the contractor. The only case we found with a named client and a stated payback.
The maker’s own calculation: 2 cleaners per shift, price RUB 2.2M, service RUB 20,000 a month.
An average by the dealer’s own claim. Integrators advertise even 3–11 months, but assume the robot replaces the whole staff.
solutions.cleaning.econ.note: Other people’s figures are sellers’ claims, and we did not verify them. We will show our own results once there are sites with agreed figures. A precise calculation comes after the site assessment.
solutions.cleaning.econ.link.label: Calculate for your site
solutions.cleaning.vendorsLead: We connect robots from these and other manufacturers to one platform. What exactly is possible with a given model, we check before you buy.
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.0.title: Site assessment
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.0.text: Area by floor type, thresholds, elevators and doors, a place for the station, the time when cleaning is allowed. We calculate payback before you invest.
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.1.title: Pilot with the platform
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.1.text: One robot (yours or one we select) at your site, connected to the platform. We measure output and quality on site, not from a spec sheet.
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.2.title: Integrations and workflows
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.2.text: We connect elevators, doors and your systems, and fine-tune the software to the process.
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.3.title: Scale and service
solutions.cleaning.pilot.items.3.text: We add robots and sites. Monitoring, tickets and maintenance run under an SLA.
solutions.cleaning.form.title: Which robot and site to start with?
solutions.cleaning.form.lead: Describe the site: area, floor type, schedule. And tell us whether you already have robots. We will suggest a path and calculate the effect.
